title: Majestic 12

tellings.quote: So, this is like a reported committee in the in the I guess 40s and 50s and like, you know, Nathan Twining, James Forrestal, Vannevar Bush, people like that.

plain: Majestic 12, or MJ-12, is described in disputed papers as a secret committee that dealt with the UFO question in the 1940s and 1950s, said to include figures such as the Air Force general Nathan Twining, the defense chief James Forrestal and the government science chief Vannevar Bush. Michels brings it up himself as a reported committee, because if real it would mean the highest levels of government were handling UFOs in secret.
